verified_facts.claim: MMR vaccine causes autism in children
verified_facts.explanation: Extensive international clinical studies involving millions of children over 25+ years have proven no causal link between the MMR vaccine and autism. The 1998 Wakefield paper was formally retracted for fraud.

verified_facts.claim: 5G mobile network radiation damages human DNA or causes COVID-19
verified_facts.explanation: 5G operates using non-ionizing radio frequencies with insufficient energy to damage DNA or biological cells, and viruses cannot travel on radio waves.

verified_facts.claim: Global average surface temperature has increased by approximately 1.1 degrees Celsius since the pre-industrial baseline
verified_facts.explanation: Global ground station and satellite measurements confirmed by NASA, NOAA, and the IPCC document an approximately 1.1C warming trend driven by greenhouse gas emissions.

verified_facts.claim: Electronic voting machines in federal elections undergo physical audits, logic tests, and paper trail verification
